name: Fabian Hedin

education.school: KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Stockholm
education.notes: Graduated 2021. Started coding at age 12; earned thousands of dollars from Minecraft as an 11-year-old.

keyDecisions: Took an Algorithm Engineer role pre-university — engineering-applied software work, not generic dev internship.
lessons: Pre-university algorithm-engineering reps compound — Hedin entered KTH already shipping production code.

keyDecisions: Stacked web dev + an ABB Robotics internship during/around KTH — mixed software and hardware-adjacent reps before founding.
lessons: Combining web dev (fast iteration) and robotics (constraint-heavy systems) is unusual and compounds well — the foundation for system-level AI products.
careerSteps.notes: Per LinkedIn-derived sources / Neon River profile.

keyDecisions: Worked alongside Anton Osika in the Stockholm AI scene (Depict.ai / Sana Labs alumni context) — co-founder pairing pre-dated Lovable.
Built engineering reps inside fast-scaling Swedish AI companies before founding.
lessons: Co-founder pairings that pre-date the company by years compress trust-building from months to zero — Osika and Hedin had history before Lovable.
Stockholm's tight AI scene (Sana Labs / Depict / Klarna / Spotify alumni) is the Swedish equivalent of the Wise-mafia for AI-native founders.
careerSteps.notes: Osika invited Hedin to co-found Lovable based on prior working relationship. Specific titles in this period not fully pinned down.

keyDecisions: Co-founded Lovable in Stockholm in 2023 with Anton Osika — natural-language-to-software platform.
Built the technical core of what became the fastest-growing software startup in history ($100M ARR in 8 months; $200M ARR by Nov 2025; $400M ARR by ~2 years in).
Pledged to donate 50% of exit proceeds to charity (with Osika) — public commitment to giving alongside building.
Stayed Sweden-based rather than relocating to SF — proved AI-native unicorns can be built from Stockholm.
lessons: Vibe-coding / natural-language-to-software is the canonical AI-revolution wedge — Lovable is the European exemplar.
$100M ARR in 8 months is achievable when the product turns AI capability directly into shippable software for non-coders.
Founded at 24 with 5+ years of pre-founder engineering reps — the technical-CTO version of the 'short ramp' pattern.
Swedish capital + Swedish talent + global distribution is a complete European AI-unicorn stack. No US relocation required.
careerSteps.notes: Founded 2023 in Stockholm. $200M Series A (mid-2025) at ~$1.8B valuation; further rounds taking valuation to $6.6B by late 2025. Hedin became a $1.6B+ net worth billionaire at age 26 — one of world's 13 self-made billionaires under 30.

outcomes.currentStatus: Co-founder & CTO of Lovable (Stockholm). $6.6B+ valuation by late 2025; $400M+ ARR in ~2 years; world's 13 self-made billionaires under 30. Pledged 50% of future exit to charity.

lessons.lesson: Vibe-coding / natural-language-to-software is the canonical AI-revolution founding wedge — Lovable is the European billion-dollar exemplar.
Pre-existing co-founder trust (Osika + Hedin worked together at Sana/Depict era) compresses founding to weeks instead of months.
Swedish AI-native unicorn stack: KTH talent + Stockholm AI alumni network + Swedish patient capital + global English-language distribution. No SF required.
Found at 24 with 5+ years of pre-founder engineering reps (algorithm eng → web dev → robotics → AI eng) is the 'technical-CTO short ramp' template.
$1.6B net worth at 26 is achievable in the AI revolution era — once a generation, not a target, but a real data point.
